name: Higgs TTS 3 (4B)

lineage.base_model: Qwen3-4B backbone with fused multi-codebook audio embedding/head

purpose: Built for voice chat: 'speaks, not just reads' with expressive conversational speech in 100+ languages, zero-shot voice cloning and inline control of emotion, style, prosody, pauses and sound effects (card).

license.name: Boson Higgs TTS 3 Research and Non-Commercial License
license.notes: License file opened (Last Updated 2026-07-08), Sections I-II read: free for Research Purpose or Non-Commercial Purpose; any commercial use needs a separate written licence; a Creator Use Grant allows monetized creative content (podcasts, videos, posts) with attribution to Boson AI's Higgs Audio; prohibited uses include voice cloning without consent. Remaining sections not read. Verdict policy (README, 2026-11-19): this licence term does not lower tona_fit; kept here for an installer label.

architecture.kind: autoregressive decoder on interleaved text and audio tokens: about 4B (36 layers, hidden 2560, GQA 32/8, context 8192), Higgs tokenizer with 8 codebooks at 25 fps with delay pattern, 24 kHz

variants.notes: gated; 89k downloads, 854 likes; also bosonai/higgs-audio-v3-tts-4b path
1.22M downloads, 9 likes: ecosystem packaging; not opened

pc-12gb.notes: 9.3 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part streams from RAM (dense: decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-16gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (13.6 GB)

pc-24gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (21.6 GB)

pc-32gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (29.6 GB)

mac-16-24gb.notes: 9.3 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 9.3 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 9.3 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

engine_support.notes: llama.cpp mtmd added 'higgs v3 STT and vibevoice-ASR' in b12426; TTS support in mainline not confirmed.

strengths: WER/CER under 5 in 85 languages and single digit in 102 (vendor); German in the polished tier
inline emotion and sound tags, zero-shot cloning
soft.maturity: Boson AI (Higgs Audio v2 widely used since 2025); strongly reused in the community (comparison column in Audio8's card).

tona_fit.reason: Best-covered multilingual expressive TTS found (German in the top tier) at 4B. Compare with Fish S2 Pro, Qwen3-TTS and Audio8 on our own German samples before any offer.

open_questions: Quality benchmarks (tier table is vendor WER/CER)
Whether llama.cpp supports the TTS model
